profile.input: authenticated original RMSNorm embedding-1 input, token 1

weighted_budget.derivation: Original frozen norm envelope covers F32 reduction/rsqrt and scale*x. Multiplication by exact F32 learned weight scales that error by abs(w); one further rounded multiply contributes u/(1-u) times its maximum magnitude. Absolute 2^-126 covers gradual or flushed subnormal multiplication. FP64 semantic-reference error is negligible relative to the norm envelope; CPU baseline must use at most 1/32 of this budget.
weighted_budget.status: Declared before any weighted GPU observation; acceptance envelope, not a measured accuracy claim

q4_oracle.q8_rounding: F32 RN-even division; integer ties away; original XOR16,8,4,2,1 sum
q4_oracle.q4_rounding: two F32 fused operations per partial; stride64; waves1,2,3; XOR16,8,4,2,1

profile.chain: Validate actual weighted GPU readback first; derive chained Q8 bytes and Q4 oracles from that readback. Never demand equality to quantized frozen CPU activation.

limitations: No weighted GPU execution or complete transformer layer claim
Pure chained_reference requires caller to validate weighted readback budget, hardware provenance and guards first; it does not enforce those itself

Historical CPU source/object provenance inherits authenticated prerequisite limitations
